import ridgeWide from './ridge-wide.jpg';
import ridgeTall from './ridge-tall.jpg';
import ridgeSquare from './ridge-square.jpg';
import flow from './flow.png';

This fixture article is written in MDX, so it can use the content components without importing them. It is built only when `CONTENT_SOURCE=fixtures` is set, into a directory that is never deployed.

## Markdown still works

Ordinary Markdown renders exactly as it does in a `.md` article, with [underlined links](/) and headings that carry anchors.

```ts
// Code blocks are highlighted with the same CSP-safe token classes.
export const answer = 42;
```
